name: TITLE_FONT
source: usage: 5-byte {u v w h flag} glyph table of the title screen texts (titleDrawText / MenuCarousel / CarouselGlyph) refs=9

name: OPTIONS_FONT
source: usage: 5-byte glyph table of the options texts (optionsDrawLabel* / screenAdjustDrawNumber) refs=10

name: OPTIONS_PAD_HAS_ACTUATOR
source: usage: short: PadInfoAct(0) != 0 at optionsMenuStep w4e 0; without it the vibration row is skipped and the cursor uses OPTIONS_CURSOR_RECTS_NO_ACTUATOR refs=8

name: TITLE_LOGO_BOUNCE_AMPLITUDE
source: usage: short: 0x1000 at titleLogoInitBounce decaying by 0x20 per frame refs=6

name: TITLE_LOGO_BOUNCE_PHASE
source: usage: u16: sine phase of the logo bounce (0x40 at init += 2 per frame) refs=4

name: TITLE_LOGO_BOUNCE_OFFSET
source: usage: short: |MulNegSin(phase amplitude) >> 4| the logo sprites are raised by refs=6

name: SCREEN_ADJUST_PAD_LAST
source: usage: int: last held direction of screenAdjustMenuStep's auto-repeat refs=4

name: SCREEN_ADJUST_PAD_REPEAT_TIMER
source: usage: int: auto-repeat countdown of screenAdjustMenuStep (0x10 then 6) refs=5

name: SCREEN_ADJUST_SAVED_X
source: usage: short: SCREEN_OFFSET_X on entering the screen adjust menu restored by circle refs=3

name: SCREEN_ADJUST_SAVED_Y
source: usage: short: SCREEN_OFFSET_Y on entering the screen adjust menu refs=3

name: OPTIONS_STRINGS
source: usage: string pointer table of the options texts (title 0 rows 1..5 sound modes 6.. vibration 9.. config names 0xF.. action labels 0x19..) refs=6

name: TITLE_STRINGS
source: usage: string pointer table of the title screen texts (titleDrawText i) refs=2

name: TITLE_STRING_PALETTES
source: usage: per TITLE_STRINGS entry the per-glyph palette list refs=2

name: OPTIONS_PAL2_GLYPH_PALETTES
source: usage: per-glyph palette list of optionsDrawLabelPal2 (clut 0x7C15) refs=2

name: OPTIONS_CURSOR_RECTS
source: usage: {short x y w h}[row] of the green cursor tile of the options menu refs=5

name: OPTIONS_CURSOR_RECTS_NO_ACTUATOR
source: usage: the cursor tile rects of rows >= 4 when the pad has no actuator refs=5

name: OPTIONS_DIGIT_STRINGS
source: usage: int[10]: digit glyph strings of screenAdjustDrawNumber refs=3

name: OPTIONS_PLUS_STRING
source: usage: the '+' glyph string before a positive screen offset refs=2

name: OPTIONS_MINUS_STRING
source: usage: the '-' glyph string before a negative screen offset refs=2

name: TITLE_MENU_GLYPHS
source: usage: short[] (-3 end 0 = gap) glyph ids of the rotating title menu carousel refs=2

name: TITLE_MENU_GLYPH_PALETTES
source: usage: u8 * : per carousel glyph the palette refs=3

name: TITLE_ARROW_RIGHT_STRING
source: usage: the right arrow string of the title menu (x 0xCC / 0xD0) refs=3

name: TITLE_ARROW_LEFT_STRING
source: usage: the left arrow string of the title menu (x 0x64 / 0x70) refs=3

name: TITLE_ARROW_RIGHT_PALETTE
source: usage: glyph palette list of TITLE_ARROW_RIGHT_STRING refs=3

name: TITLE_ARROW_LEFT_PALETTE
source: usage: glyph palette list of TITLE_ARROW_LEFT_STRING refs=3

name: BOOT_LOGO_SPRITE_RECS
source: usage: -1 terminated SprRec list of the boot logo (bootLogoDraw) refs=2

name: TITLE_LOGO_SPRITE_RECS
source: usage: SprRec list of the bouncing title logo (titleLogoDraw with -TITLE_LOGO_BOUNCE_OFFSET) refs=2

name: TITLE_LOGO_STATIC_SPRITE_RECS
source: usage: SprRec list of the title logo parts that do not bounce refs=2

name: OPTIONS_MENU_SPRITES
source: usage: SprDef list of the options menu (optionsMenuDrawText) refs=2

name: BUTTON_CONFIG_SPRITES
source: usage: SprDef list of the button config screen (buttonConfigDrawText) refs=2

name: SCREEN_ADJUST_SPRITES
source: usage: SprDef list of the screen adjust frame (screenAdjustDrawText) refs=2

name: OPTIONS_FRAME_SPRITES
source: usage: SprDef list (tpage 1 0 0x180) of the frame shared by the three option screens (optionsDrawFrame) refs=2

source: usage: the sprite data bootLogoSetSpriteBase stores into SEQ_DATA (8009D630) before the boot logo refs=2
